about: Decision types (rework plan S13): fields in, the decision text out, or the first reason they write none. qvault/services/decision_types.py and mobile/src/logic/decisionTypes.ts must both give exactly these results (tests/test_decision_types.py, tests/test_mobile_decision_types.py). 'version' is passed only when present. A case with 'text' null and no 'problem' is a payment its generator refuses.
